# Original university demonstration fixture

`review.c` contains three actual C definitions and an observed entry→sum_values call.
`helpers.py` contains one Python definition. This is original educational fixture code,
not a Devign sample, labeled defect benchmark or proof of safety/vulnerability. The
trained model's actual results are observations only. Never train on invented labels.

Build a temporary ZIP using the commands in docs/task7a_demo_checklist.md. The app reads
source without compiling/executing it. Real artifact inference is required for the demo;
missing artifacts must produce the existing unavailable state, never substitute scores.
